content: Doubt is the sacred key to the portal of genuine knowledge; he who doubts nothing examines nothing.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: Blind belief inherited from childhood is merely comfortable conformity. True wisdom begins when the soul dares to ask honest questions, strip away inherited assumptions, and examine the bedrock of reality with intellectual courage.
practicalInsight: Question one assumption you hold about yourself or the world today. Look at it with fresh, curious eyes.
reflectionPrompt: What belief are you fiercely defending simply because you were told to believe it, without personal examination?
